about: Does a template make a better film for less than the same content asked for as a prompt? Three real upcoming conferences (none Russia-linked; see each form's sources.md) are written out as what a person would type and attach: a big English one with 24 speakers, a small one whose site serves only 128 px photos, and a Ukrainian one. Arm 'template' remakes the template as asked (--mode template); arm 'prompt' sends the same words and pictures as a plain 30 s film (--mode prompt; six pictures at most). The forms and pictures are local (temp/bakeoff/, third-party content). Bars (plan, 2026-09-30): every template film inside the time limit, fidelity >= 4, no sample left over, at least a point more professional than the prompt arm at half its Claude cost or less. The -web prompts are a line anyone would type, with nothing attached (template v5: no form): Claude reads the site, brings in the logo and the speakers' photos and remakes the film; mate-web asks in Ukrainian.
